package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"

	_ "github.com/lib/pq"
)

// scenario for root_main_go_in_layered_service_repo: Layered service repos that keep the primary binary at repository-root `main.go` instead of `cmd/<name>/main.go`.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type OrderRepository struct {
	db *sql.DB
}

func NewOrderRepository(db *sql.DB) *OrderRepository {
	return &OrderRepository{db: db}
}

type OrderService struct {
	repo *OrderRepository
}

func NewOrderService(repo *OrderRepository) *OrderService {
	return &OrderService{repo: repo}
}

func runApp() {
	db, err := sql.Open("postgres", "host=localhost dbname=app sslmode=disable")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	defer db.Close()
	repo := NewOrderRepository(db)
	svc := NewOrderService(repo)

	http.HandleFunc("/api/orders", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		fmt.Fprint(w, "orders endpoint")
	})
	fmt.Println("listening on :8080", svc)
	http.ListenAndServe(":8080", nil)
}
